title: 第一卷 第380章 大舅哥初次见面火气别这么大第一卷 第379章 奇了怪了
slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 随着众人的不断深入，周围的景象开始发生变化。
原本遮天蔽日的参天大树逐渐变得稀疏，空气中，一股清新的气息扑面而来。
古榕深吸了一口气，眼中闪过一丝惊讶。
这里的空气中，竟然蕴含着微量的生命能量。
身处这种环境中，哪怕是不刻意运转魂力，他也能感觉到自身的身体明显轻松下来。
千道流同样眉头微挑，目光在四周扫视。
他体内的天使魂力，自然也对生命能量极为敏感。
这里的生命能量纯度，即便是他这个眼高的当代天使神大祭司，也感到讶异。
很快，前方的视野豁然开朗。
一个巨大的湖泊出现在众人眼前。
湖水澄澈见底，泛着淡淡的蓝光，水面上氤氲着一层薄薄的白雾，湖畔长满了各种奇花异草。
这便是生命之湖。
二明走到湖边，将宁天和小舞放了下来。
宁天四下打量了一番，点了点头。
这地方，如果用来盖个别墅度假，倒是个不错的选择。
就在这时，原本平静的湖面突然开始剧烈翻滚。
湖中心形成了一个巨大的旋涡，水流急速旋转。
紧接着，一颗巨大的头颅从旋涡中心缓缓探出。
那是一颗牛首，两根粗壮的牛角直刺苍穹，眼眸中闪烁青光。
在那颗巨大的牛首之下，连接着的是一条庞大青黑色蛇身。
与此同时，十万年魂兽的气息瞬间毫无保留地释放出来。
随后，它的目光第一时间锁定了站在岸边的千道流和古榕。
封号斗罗，两个？
顿时，它的瞳孔猛地收缩，青光大盛。
这种级别的强者，就算是在它漫长的生命中，也极少会出现在星斗大森林的核心区。
随后，大明的目光落在了小舞身上，接着又看到了站在小舞身旁、正肆无忌惮搂着小舞腰肢的宁天。
这一下，它顿时懵了。
难道，是小舞被人类抓住了？
“人类，放开她。”
情急之下，大明直接口吐人言。
话音未落，大明根本不给众人解释的机会，直接发动了天赋领域。
迟缓领域。
顿时，青色的光芒从大明体内呈环形扩散而出，瞬间笼罩了过去。
见对方如此，古榕冷哼一声，身上空间之力涌动，强行在迟缓领域中撑开了一片空间。
千道流则是目光一冷。
他这个当代天使神大祭司，99级绝世斗罗，被一头魂兽用领域压制？
这对他来说，简直是挑衅。
顿时，刺目的金光在千道流掌心汇聚，天使圣剑即将成型。
就在这剑拔弩张的瞬间，一只手搭在了千道流的肩膀上。
“老头，不急，不急。“
开口之人，正是宁天。
他笑眯眯地把千道流正在凝聚圣剑的手按了下去。
content_en:
As people continued to go deeper, the surrounding scene began to change.
The towering trees that originally blocked the sky gradually became sparse, and a fresh breath blew in the air.
Gu Rong took a deep breath, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.
The air here actually contains a trace amount of life energy.
In this environment, even if he is not deliberately using his soul power, he can feel that his body is obviously relaxed.
Qian Daoliu also raised his eyebrows slightly and glanced around.
The angel soul power in his body is naturally extremely sensitive to life energy.
The purity of the life energy here surprised even him, the high-minded contemporary high priest of the angel god.
Soon, the view ahead suddenly became clear.
A huge lake appeared in front of everyone.
The lake is crystal clear, glowing with a faint blue light, with a thin layer of white mist on the water. The lakeside is covered with various exotic flowers and plants.
This is the Lake of Life.
Erming walked to the lake and put Ning Tian and Xiao Wu down.
Ning Tian looked around and nodded.
If this place is used to build a villa for vacation, it would be a good choice.
At this moment, the originally calm lake surface suddenly began to roll violently.
A huge vortex formed in the center of the lake, and the water swirled rapidly.
Immediately afterwards, a huge head slowly poked out from the center of the vortex.
It was an ox head, with two thick horns piercing the sky, and blue light flashing in its eyes.
Under the huge bull head, connected is a huge green-black snake body.
At the same time, the aura of the 100,000-year-old soul beast was instantly released without reservation.
Then, its eyes immediately locked onto Qian Daoliu and Gu Rong standing on the shore.
Titled Douluo, two?
Suddenly, its pupils shrank suddenly, and the green light glowed.
A strong person of this level would rarely appear in the core area of ​​the Star Dou Forest even in its long life.
Then, Daming's eyes fell on Xiao Wu, and then he saw Ning Tian standing next to Xiao Wu, holding Xiao Wu's waist unscrupulously.
This time, it was suddenly confused.
This...
Could it be that Xiao Wu was caught by humans?
"Human, let her go."
In desperation, Daming spoke directly.
Before he finished speaking, Daming directly activated his talent field without giving everyone a chance to explain.
Slow field.
Suddenly, cyan light spread out from Daming's body in a ring shape, covering it instantly.
Seeing the other party acting like this, Gu Rong snorted coldly, and the power of space in his body surged, forcibly opening up a space in the slow field.
Qian Daoliu's eyes turned cold.
He, the contemporary high priest of the angel god, a level 99 peerless Douluo, was suppressed by a soul beast using his domain?
To him, this was simply a provocation.
Suddenly, dazzling golden light gathered in Qian Daoliu's palm, and the angel holy sword was about to take shape.
At this tense moment, a hand was placed on Qian Daoliu's shoulder.
"Old man, don't be in a hurry, don't be in a hurry."
The person who spoke was none other than Ning Tian.
He smiled and pressed Qian Daoliu's hand that was condensing the holy sword.
